name: unsafe fn reborrow_shared (& self) -> & 'a T
rule: For safety when calling `reborrow_shared`, the reborrow must have ended: the reference returned by `new` and all pointers and references derived from it must not be used anymore.
api: impl < 'a , T > alloc::collections::btree::borrow::DormantMutRef < 'a , T > { unsafe fn reborrow_shared (& self) -> & 'a T }
expression: No faithful expression exists in the supplied DSL: current-state observations cannot express that a reborrow has ended and its derived pointers and references will no longer be used.
